remarks: Bright and welcoming, this 2-bedroom, 1-bath single-level home offers a comfortable alternative to apartment living in a quiet Wilton setting. The family room features a floor-to-ceiling stone fireplace and large windows that bring in natural light and overlook the level backyard. The kitchen includes stainless-steel appliances, good counter space, great pantry storage, and a pass-through to a versatile room that can be used for dining or as flexible space for an office, study, or playroom. Both bedrooms are nicely sized with useful closet storage. The full bath offers a tiled tub/shower, a window for added light, and a full-size washer and dryer for in-unit laundry. Outdoor space is right outside your door, with a yard bordered by mature evergreens. Parking is conveniently located in front of the unit, and you're close to schools, Wilton Center, shops, restaurants, trails, and commuter routes. A clean, bright, and practical place to call home.
